Energy & Inputs.title: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $110 in September?
Energy & Inputs.why_it_matters: Lower-probability outcome (36%) that crude reach $110. Closes in 14d. Would lift farm diesel and pass through to nitrogen fertilizer cost within a few months.

Energy & Inputs.title: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (LOW) $80 in September?
